issues.description: Method addGuestStudents(int): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares addGuestStudents(int) with return type void, but the solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) defines public boolean addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). This return-type difference between the specification and the provided solution will confuse students about the expected method signature and may cause tests or autograders that expect a void method to fail or be inconsistent.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the exercise specification: change the solution method signature to 'public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)' and remove the boolean return and related boolean logic; simply update the numberOfGuestStudents field by adding the provided value. Alternatively, if a success indicator is required by design, update the problem statement UML and description to specify a boolean return type and explain the return semantics. Prefer keeping the specification (UML) unchanged and updating the solution to void to avoid changing the exercise requirements.
